jia_ml: Quick heads-up — int4-v2 onboard (shadow -> small AB 2%) shows a clear drop on the long-doc slice (>2k tokens). Baseline v2p3 rouge-L 0.67 -> int4-v2 0.61. p=0.03 across ~1.2k samples. Need to discuss gate behavior.

sam_reliability: Ack. Do we see latency or safety regressions, or mostly fidelity (omission/truncation)?

jia_ml: Latency and error rates unchanged. Qualitative: more omission of tail instructions and occasional early stop on long prompts. I added a couple of diffs below.

carla_prod: Is this from the pilot cohort or global AB? Which traffic slice is affected?

jia_ml: Pilot config: 2% global, cohort name `longdocs` targets >2k token queries. Delta-eval used same prompt corpus. Also ran rerank concordance; that dropped ~4 pts.

omar_ops: Could we require a slice-level hysteresis for promotion? e.g., require delta > 0.04 and p < 0.05 AND consistency over 3 snapshots before blocking promotion.

sam_reliability: +1 to hysteresis. Also propose auto-rollback: if any safety/fidelity slice MRR drops > 3 pts AND global composite delta negative for 24h, then swap to baseline automatically.

jia_ml: Proposed gate snippet (draft):
```json
{
  "slice_rules": [
    {"slice":"longdocs","delta_threshold":0.04,"pval_threshold":0.05,"consistency_windows":3}
  ],
  "auto_fallback": {"window_hours":24,"global_delta_threshold":-0.01,"rollback_action":"swap_to_baseline"}
}
```

eval-bot: Eval run 4312345678-int4v2-longdocs: samples=1200, rougeL_delta=-0.06, p=0.028, mrr_delta=-0.035. Full CSV: https://ci.internal/evals/4312345678 (private link).

carla_prod: If we tighten the gate, how much will it slow rollout cadence? product needs an ETA on stable promote to avoid blocking customer launches.

jia_ml: Tightening will add a 48h hold for longdocs (require no slice regressions >0.03 for 48h). That likely pushes promote by one extra window for the current candidate. I'll open a PR to the rollout config with notes.

sam_reliability: Also add an alert rule: on auto_fallback trigger create incident in #incidents + DM the oncall for 30m, include sample diffs and top-failure pairs.

omar_ops: I'll push the config change to the canary gate and schedule the holdback for the next promote run. ETA ~2h.

jia_ml: Thanks — I'll attach top 10 failing pairs and the short notebook with reproducible seeds. @carla_prod please review the examples when you have a minute :eyes:
